ui-login.delete.managed: Deleting clears this own account's sign-in credentials and local CLI data on the node, and cancels a sign-in under way. Sessions that use it can still be read but can no longer send.
ui-login.delete.other: After deleting, it no longer shows in the profile list; your CLI sign-in on the server itself is not affected. Sessions that use it can still be read but can no longer send.
ui-login.pin.changed: PIN changed. Every earlier PIN grant is void.
ui-login.pin.dialogNote: Once entered, actions like this need no PIN for a few minutes.
ui-login.pin.intro: Actions that let other people in (opening the outside face, changing the passcode, open links for other machines) all need the PIN. {product} keeps only a check value. Resetting it is only possible on this machine's command line: {command} pin reset.
ui-login.pin.lockedUntil: Too many wrong tries: locked until {until}.
ui-login.pin.new: New PIN (at least 6 characters; digits only is fine)
ui-login.pin.noApi: This {product} has no PIN interface yet (it needs an update). The PIN guards the actions that let other people in; you can also set it on the command line with {command} pin set.
ui-login.pin.setDone: PIN set: the AI can start working.
ui-login.steps.authCode: Authorization code from the official page
ui-login.steps.authCodePlaceholder: Paste the authorization code, not your password
ui-login.steps.deviceCode: Enter the device code on the official page
